* Coordinate with the technical team to prepare BOQs, project estimates, and commercial proposals.

* Maintain a strong sales pipeline and follow up on leads and proposals.
* Identify opportunities for EV charging station installation, AMC/O&M, and related services.
 
 Qualification & Experience 
 
* B.Tech / Diploma / MBA / equivalent qualification.
* 1-6 years of experience in project management, business development, electrical infrastructure, EV charging, or a related field.
* Experience in EV chargers, electrical installations, or infrastructure projects will be an advantage.

 The
